description.value: Thai Basil is a Thai restaurant established in 2008 that has grown to four Vancouver locations; the West Broadway outpost sits in the Kitsilano area and offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery. The menu spans curries, noodle soups, salads, and appetizers with broad protein options including tofu. OSM records outdoor seating at this location.
